main_text.p: accedit q; uteri præfocationis, quæ immo-deratiori mensiū euacuationi succedit ua-por, nō uenenatus esse potest, nec nisi ute-ro immodicè refrigerato cies,ut &q; exsup-prelsis mesibus excitari solet.Nā tū sangui-nē deferuefcere certissimū est. Deinde ab odorib.gratis puta zybetthi,moschi, amba-ri,agallochi, & cæterorū id genus odorato-rū, quæ quidē omni ueneni suspicione ca-rent,imò pestis,q uenenū est, alexipharma-ca sunt, uteri præfocatione excitari,omni-bus plusq; est notū. Igitur nō omnis uapor strangulatum uteri efficiens est uenenatus. Quòd autem putrefactum semen ueneni sit particeps,nihil sanè mirari oportet. Quò enim quippiam excellit,dum corrumpitur eò deterius fit: quandoquidem omnis mu-tatio,semper fit in contrarium. Propterea hominis caro, quæ omnium perfectissima est,summè putrefacta in pestiferam causam degenerat. Idcirco Laulannæ, anno Domi-ni milesimo,qngentesimo & septuagesimo secundo, ueneficis unguentis ex humani cadaueris carne putrefacta cofectis impul-su Sathanæ, pestis sparsa ac renouata fuit. Semen igitur,quod percoctum est,& natu-ra spirituosum,dum corrumpitur, in mali-gnam

page.notes: Catchword "gnam" at the foot right is the continuation of the last word "malignam" split at the line end; it is recorded in the text as the word's remainder. Printed spellings kept as found, including "milesimo", "qngentesimo", "Laulannæ", "cofectis", "zybetthi", "Sathanæ", "uteri præfocatione" and the abbreviation "q;" for -que. Long s transcribed as plain s. Possibly inconsistent marks: "q" with stroke in "q;" and "q" with superscript in "q uenenū" are kept as printed-style abbreviations. The line "accedit q; uteri..." begins a fragment at the page top, as the page is mid-paragraph.
